scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,qdiabetes,fracatlas -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @healthcare/api" "npm run dev -w @healthcare/web" "python3 -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir services/qdiabetes --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001" "if [ -x services/fracatlas/.venv/bin/python ]; then services/fracatlas/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --app-dir services/fracatlas --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8003; else echo 'Run npm run setup:fracatlas to enable FracAtlas.'; fi"
scripts.setup:symptom-classifier: python3 -m venv services/symptom_classifier/.venv && services/symptom_classifier/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade 'pip<26' && services/symptom_classifier/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r services/symptom_classifier/requirements.txt
scripts.setup:fracatlas: python3.11 -m venv services/fracatlas/.venv && services/fracatlas/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade 'pip<26' && services/fracatlas/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r services/fracatlas/requirements.txt
scripts.build: npm run build -w @healthcare/shared && npm run build -w @healthcare/api && npm run build -w @healthcare/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @healthcare/shared && npm run typecheck -w @healthcare/api && npm run typecheck -w @healthcare/web
